paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.74% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+1.05%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.03%). Brent crude changed +2.74% to 111.8. Gold changed -1.23% to 4,099.0. Bitcoin changed -2.53% to 81,890.0312. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.146%, a relative move of +0.57%. Among the firms tracked, Morgan Stanley (+3.66%) and Glencore (-2.46%) moved the most.
